title: Biological Quarantine Transfer: Implementing Containment Protocols for Flagged AI Agent Behaviors
original_idea: Design and implement a tiered containment response protocol for ControlArena with 4 severity levels (shadow mode, rate limiting, soft halt, hard halt). Evaluate which protocol achieves best outcome (minimal disruption + maximum sabotage prevention) on SHADE-Arena.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong theory: detection without response is incomplete safety design. Specifying and evaluating response protocols fills a real gap in AI control research. Clear causal chain from response protocol to safety outcome.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing 4 different containment mechanisms in ControlArena requires understanding the framework's internals. Injecting delays, halts, and logging requires software engineering. Feasible in 30hrs but needs ControlArena familiarity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Implementing 4 different response protocols and evaluating each is substantial. Defining the optimization metric (disruption vs prevention trade-off) adds design complexity. Moderately scoped.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
